title: Safety Glass (Quality Control )Amendment Order, 2022
text: F.No.P-14031/99/2020-C.I Government of India Ministry of Commerce & Industry (Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade) (Consumer Industry Section) Udyog Bhavan, New Delhi Dated: \";J-February,2022 To, (As per the list attached) Subject: - Safety Glass (Quality Control )Amendment Order,2022- Reg. Sir/ Madam, The undersigned is directed to enclose herewith a copy of Safety Glass (Quality Control) Amendment Order, 2022 published in the Extra-ordinary Gazette of India vide notification S.O. No. 620 (E) dated 11.02.2022 for your information and necessary action. 2. Industries/ Associations are requested to utilize this extended period to clear their certification issues that are pending with BIS. Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) is requested to give wide publicity to this QCO which comes into force w.e.f 01.04.2023 and help the industry to complete the certification process & prepare itself for the implementation of the QCO. 3. This issues with the approval of competent authority. Short title and commencement.-(l) This Order may be called the Safety Glass (Quality Control) AmendmentOrder, 2022. (2) It shall come into force on the date of its publicationin the Official Gazette. 2. In the Safety Glass (Quality Control) Order, 2020 in paragraph 1, for sub-paragraph(2), the following sub-paragraphshall be substituted, namely:- "(2) It shall come into force with effect from 151April, 2023.". [F. No. 14031199/2020-CI] ANIL AGRAWAL, Addl, Secy. Note : The principal Order was published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section(ii) vide number S.O. 1045(E), dated the 12th March,2020 and last Order amended vide S.O. 902(E),datedthe 25th February,2021.
